name: FELCON CLEAN ROOM TECHNOLOGY (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Felcon India has a significant presence in India, with a history dating back to 1988 and a focus on the 'Make in India' initiative.
summary: Felcon Clean Room Technology (India) Private Limited specializes in providing wet processing equipment and modular cleanroom construction solutions for the semiconductor industry. They focus on delivering high-quality and precise products to meet the needs of their clients, particularly in the context of India's growing semiconductor sector.
